title: PHP AST Boundary Operations
rootCause: Exported free-function constructors bypassed the interface-first runtime contract.
The parser-boundary judgment was data-only and included a reasoning workflow label.
Runtime consumers could read the AST payload directly without invoking the judgment's domain operation.
changes: Replace exported phpAstBoundaryFact/phpAstBoundaryJudgment constructors with phpAstBoundaryOperations: PhpAstBoundaryOperationsInterface.
Add continueWith handlers for adapted AST and parser-gap outcomes.
Bind continuation at the judgment producer.
Route boundaryAdapter and nodeMapper runtime usage through the operation.
Export the operation and its contracts explicitly through PHP and CLI barrels.

verification.fullTypecheck: not verified; workspace TypeScript/toolchain and dependency limitations remain
